tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lce btsun chen po bi ma'i zab tig gi smin khrid nyams len byed pa'i skabs thun mong dang*/ khyad par gyi skyabs sems zhag bdun/ bsags sbyangs zhag bdun/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor phyag dang bcas zhag bcu drug bcas khyon zla ba gcig tu gnad du smin par grub rjes dngos gzhi nyams len gyi dang po kun bzang don phrin gyi bsnyen sgrub zla ba gsum dang zhag bcu ste nyin zhag brgya la brtson/ tshogs skong zhag gcig /de skabs skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa'i 'phros yig brgya dang*/ a ho ma hā su kha sogs tshogs sbyar/ thun re yig brgya sum brgya las mi nyung ba btang*/ de nas bgegs bskrad phyin mthar chags su btang ste spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol grub rjes mdun gyi bi ma lar dmigs nas 'od gsal snang bzhi sogs gsol 'debs thun rer sum brgya/ bi ma la'i mtshan sngags stong phrag re gtang*/ las byang gi phyag mchod bstod pa'i bar btang ste bskyed pa'i rim par rnam pa gsal ba nga rgyal brtan pa rnam dag dran pa rnam lce btsun snying thig gi khrid yig tu mi gsal bas rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i bsnyen yig nang bzhin sbyar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru siṃ he shwa ra grangs ji tsam mang bzhin legs/ thun mthar bum can dang sbrag pa'i rdor bzlas nyer gcig re bya nyer bsdu'i skabs zhi gnas la sems yun ring gtad pa gal che/ dngos gzhi khyad par gyi sngon 'gro'i lus sbyongs zhag bdun/ ngag sbyongs phyi'i snang ba hūm̐ du bsam pa dang*/ nang lus hūm̐ gi gang ba zhag nyer gcig /hūm̐ gis snang ba dang lus thams cad gtor ba zhag bdun/ sems byung gnas 'gro gsum btsal ba zhag bdun/ rnal dbab sor gzhug gnyis zhag bdun bar 'bad/ thun mthar mi pham rin po che'i rdzogs chen smon lam gdab bo// // PAGE PAGE 2 FILENAME 12-13.doc
